start: Shop, Products tab, a product with the drawn picture and no photo

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo' on the product card and pick a phone photo (6 MB, taken sideways)
user_sees: The button reads 'Uploading…' and the card is busy
Then 'Photo added to <product>. Members see it in the app now.'
The photo on the card, upright
must_not: The product lying on its side
Price, stock or name changed by adding a photo
The full 6 MB file sent

steps.action: Open the shop in the member app
user_sees: The photo on the product tile
must_not: The drawn picture still shown
Another product's photo

start: The product sheet ('+ Add product' or edit a product)

steps.action: Tap 'Upload photo', or drag a photo onto the picture
user_sees: 'Uploading photo…' and Save is off while it uploads
The photo in the sheet, the button now 'Change photo'
'Members see this photo in the app. Remove it to show the drawn picture instead.'
must_not: The product saved while the photo is still uploading
A second upload started by a second pick

steps.action: Save the product
user_sees: The product in the list with its photo
must_not: The photo lost on save
The photo shown to members before the product is saved

start: Set up your gym, the gym web page photos (the other kind this uploader serves)

steps.action: Add a photo to the gym web page
user_sees: unknown: the gym web page has its own photo code in another folder, which this step did not open; no gym page screen was found calling the product photo uploader
must_not: A gym page photo stored among product photos
A photo over the size limit accepted

steps.action: Pick a PDF
user_sees: 'That file isn’t a photo. Pick a JPEG or PNG picture.'
must_not: The file uploaded
The product left busy

steps.action: Pick an iPhone HEIC photo in a browser that cannot read it
user_sees: 'This photo can’t be read here (iPhone HEIC photos often can’t). Save it as JPEG or PNG and try again.'
must_not: A black or empty picture saved

steps.action: Pick a photo over 40 MB, then an empty file
user_sees: 'That photo is too big to use (over 40 MB). Pick a smaller one.'
'That file is empty. Pick another photo.'
must_not: The browser freezing

steps.action: Pick a good photo with the internet off
user_sees: 'Can’t reach the internet, so the photo didn’t upload. Check the connection and try again.'
The product as it was
must_not: 'Photo added' shown
The product pointing at a photo that is not there

steps.action: Add many photos within a few minutes
user_sees: 'Too many photo uploads in the last few minutes. Wait a little and try again.'
must_not: Raw server words

steps.action: Open the product, tap 'Change photo', pick another, save
user_sees: The new photo on the card and in the app
must_not: The old photo still shown to members after a reload

steps.action: Remove the photo and save
user_sees: The drawn picture again
'A clear photo on a plain background works best. You can also drag a photo onto the picture.'
must_not: A broken-picture mark

steps.action: Add a photo again
user_sees: The photo back, under a new file name
must_not: An error because the old file name is taken

steps.action: Pick a photo in the sheet, then close the sheet without saving
user_sees: The product keeps its old picture
must_not: The unsaved photo shown to members

steps.action: Look at who can open the photo
user_sees: Product photos are public pictures: anyone with the address can open one
The photo is re-drawn in the browser before upload, so only the picture leaves the phone
must_not: The place or time the photo was taken left inside the uploaded file
A photo address that names the gym or the owner
A person outside the gym able to put a photo on this gym’s product

steps.action: Remove the photo from the product
user_sees: Members no longer see it in the app
must_not: The owner told the file is deleted when it still opens by its address

start: Shop page, signed in as front desk staff

steps.action: Open Shop
user_sees: The Orders tab only
No Products tab, no 'Add photo' and no '+ Add product'
must_not: A way for staff to change a product picture

steps.action: Look at an order line
user_sees: The product with the photo the owner added
must_not: A broken picture where the owner removed the photo

start: Signed in as staff, the address /shop/products typed by hand

steps.action: Open /shop/products
user_sees: The Orders tab opens instead
must_not: The Products tab shown to staff
A blank page

steps.action: Ask the server for an upload ticket with a staff sign-in
user_sees: The server refuses: only an owner gets a ticket
must_not: A staff sign-in able to upload or attach a product photo

start: Signed in as staff while the owner changes a product photo

steps.action: Owner adds a photo; staff reloads Shop
user_sees: Still only Orders; pictures in orders follow the product
must_not: An upload control appearing for staff after the change

steps.action: The person is made an owner and signs in again
user_sees: The Products tab and its photo buttons appear
must_not: The owner tools missing after the role change
The tools showing before the new sign-in
